pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 36
   D. 6

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 169

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 7

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 16

8. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 20

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

18. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

20. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

24. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 9
   C. 7
   D. 6

25. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

27. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

28. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

29. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

30. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 11
